parts.text:
In this experiment it is important that the card is able to swing freely. For this reason the
plumbline should not touch the card, but be a small distance from the card. This could
cause an inaccuracy in marking the card at the correct position (part (b)(iii)).
Describe how you minimised the possible inaccuracy. You may draw a diagram.
